items.information: 🇧🇷 Bem-vindos ao Itajaí ao Cubo 2026. A inscrição somente será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, o qual deverá ser realizado de forma antecipada. Mais informações estão disponíveis na aba “Inscrever”. Caso tenha dificuldades para se inscrever, assista ao vídeo explicativo: 👉 https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Solicitamos que todos os competidores leiam atentamente o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Haverá premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais, além de premiação extra-oficial nas categorias: Feminino Iniciantes (modalidade Cubo 3x3x3) ATENÇÃO! Informamos que o cronograma pode ser adiantado ao longo do dia, por isso esteja no local para competir pelo menos 30 minutos antes da sua modalidade começar. ⚠️ Inscrições no local serão aceitas exclusivamente para a modalidade 3x3x3. 🇺🇸 Welcome to Itajaí ao Cubo 2026. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance. More information is available in the “Register” section. If you have difficulties with registration, please watch this instructional video: 👉 https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 All competitors are kindly requested to read the WCA Regulations carefully before the competition. There will be awards for all official events, as well as extra (unofficial) awards for: Female competitors Beginners in the 3x3x3 Cube event ATTENTION! Please note that the schedule may be brought forward throughout the day, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. ⚠️ On-site registration will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: ### Português **Atencão:** Chegamos ao limite de inscrições, isso significa que novas inscrições serão aceitas **somente caso haja alguma desistência**. Neste caso, entraremos em contato com todos os inscritos não confirmados via e-mail, daremos um período para que respondam manifestando interesse, e aprovaremos as inscrições pela ordem que foram feitas, mediante pagamento da taxa de inscrição (R$20). Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa. #### Utilização de imagem Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso. ### English: **Attention:** We have reached the competitor limit, which means that new registrations will only be accepted **if there is a cancellation**. In that case, we'll reach out to all not confirmed registered competitors through email. We'll give a time window answer, saying they're still interested in participating, and we'll approve the registrations in the order they happened, after paying the registration fee (R$20). This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** so your spot can be given to someone else. #### Image use It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1MDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ccd65f403457dc282c8579d38ca9bea44c3a8e26/636674475_1225483876408329_1643318046908654871_n.jpg) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Β μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Τα events 3x3 και 2x2 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα Skewb, Clock, Blind ή 4x4, Pyraminx επιθυμείτε. Μετά τη μεγάλη επιτυχία του πρώτου διαγωνισμού του 2026 που έγινε για πρώτη φορά στο Panellinios Club House, η λαϊκή απαίτηση ήταν να επαναληφθεί ένας διαγωνισμός σύντομα στο ίδιο μέρος! Ελάτε με τους κύβους σας να περάσουμε όμορφες στιγμές με το αγαπημένο μας χόμπι. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Easter Fever Athens Β 2026.** Αγωνίσματα Β' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Attention:** This competition is Part B of a series of two competitions. You may participate in **only one of the two.** The 3x3 and 2x2 events are included in both competitions, so choose carefully which day or which of the Skewb, Clock, Blind or 4x4, Pyraminx you would like to compete in. After the great success of the first 2026 competition, which was held for the first time at the Panellinios Club House, popular demand called for another competition to be organized soon at the same venue! Bring your cubes and join us to enjoy great moments with our favorite hobby. We look forward to seeing you at **Easter Fever Athens B 2026.** Events of Competition B: * 3x3 * 2x2 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration on the competition’s WCA page **AND** pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026 Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder. Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede. Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. --- ### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026 Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests. The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy. Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUyNzY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--52b589b7024452b0af80173384400764db1a004b/allstars(1).png) # IMPORTANT Utah All-Stars 2026 is a unique competition that has been organized in parallel with Utah Newcomers 2026. Both competitions will happen on the same day in the same venue. All-Stars is an exciting opportunity for the best of Utah to compete against each other. If you are an experienced competitor, even if you don't consider yourself to be the best of the best, we ask that you register for this competition. If you are a first time or less experienced competitor (competed for the first time in 2024, 2025, 2026 or otherwise consider yourself to be less experienced), we strongly encourage you to register for Utah Newcomers, as the scheduling of both competitions has been tailored specifically to improve the expereince for you. The most unique aspect of this competition is how the schedules have been interleaved. For each event, the finals of All-Stars will immediately preceed the first round of the same event of this competition. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Go to our [Website](https://utahcubing.org/) to find upcoming Utah Cubing Association competitions! Here you can also find our Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server. items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** Sejam todos bem-vindos à mais uma competição Capivara em parceria com o Colégio SEB Dom Bosco! Esta é uma edição muito especial, em homenagem ao Mês da Mulher. Para celebrar essa data tão importante, teremos pódios femininos em todas as modalidades, incluindo a categoria iniciante. Chamem suas amigas e venham comemorar conosco esse momento de reconhecimento e valorização! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=OQ1vLrsJVqagiDna). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). **English** Welcome to one other Capivara competition in partnership with *Colégio SEB Dom Bosco*! This is a very special edition, held in honor of Women’s Month. To celebrate this important occasion, we will have female podiums in all event categories, including the beginner category. Invite your friends and come celebrate this meaningful and empowering moment with us! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IICapixabaChallenge2025/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! items.information: Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады. Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет. АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін. Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады. Жарыс Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары холлда өтеді. Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды. Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз English: The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia. Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery. The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device. The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment. The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall. Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life. We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU2MTYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--79dbfce9e58533dbaf7d175169cad3509ba05840/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-01-17%20at%2000.39.05.jpeg) ###### Español Las iguanas vuelven a salir al sol. Un año despues, Vallarta Speed vuelve a la escena y anuncia un nuevo torneo en casa esta vez siendo NxN. La cita es en Nuevo Vallarta, Nayarit, los dias 7 y 8 de Marzo del 2026 para girar cubos, convivir y pasarla increíble. Este es un desafio NxN, con categorías que van desde 2x2 hasta 7x7 y OH donde la velocidad, la concentración y la resistencia se ponen a prueba. Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English The iguanas are back in the sun. A year later, Vallarta Speed returns to the scene and announces a new tournament at home, this time as an NxN event. The event will take place in Nuevo Vallarta, Nayarit, on March 7th and 8th, 2026, for cube solving, camaraderie, and an amazing time. This is an NxN challenge, with categories ranging from 2x2 to 7x7 and OH, where speed, concentration, and endurance will be put to the test. This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association (WCA) event. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Rules](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1NDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--72b0f75423beefdc650f133783cee9ed7de0cd11/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-01-13%20at%2010.05.16%20AM.jpeg) Esta competencia forma parte de una serie de tres eventos que se desarrollarán a lo largo del año 2026, coincidiendo con los tres períodos académicos. El objetivo principal de esta serie es fortalecer el desarrollo del speedcubing en Honduras, brindar más oportunidades de competencia oficial y contribuir a la mejora progresiva de los tiempos y rankings a nivel nacional. El evento se llevará a cabo en la Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, campus Comayagua, institución que brinda el espacio y apoyo logístico para la realización de competencias oficiales WCA, reconociendo el valor educativo, formativo y tecnológico del speedcubing. _______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ This competition is part of a series of three events that will take place throughout 2026, corresponding to the three academic periods. The main objective of this series is to strengthen the development of speedcubing in Honduras, provide more opportunities for official competition, and contribute to the progressive improvement of national times and rankings. The event will be held at Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Comayagua campus, which provides the venue and logistical support for the organization of official WCA competitions, recognizing the educational, formative, and technological value of speedcubing.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 20 février 2026 à 22h.** Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday, February 20th, 2026 at 10 pm.** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). ❗️**IMPORTANTE** Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) 💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵 Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). ❗️❗️**IMPORTANT** This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page. 💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵 In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page. If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

Tras 8 años, y de la mano de la **Preparatoria Federal por Cooperación Gilberto Martínez Gutiérrez**, el desafío del Cubo Rubik regresa a la cuna del maíz, donde la velocidad, estrategia y visión de halcón se ponen a prueba. Halcones Tehuacán 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **English** Tehuacán takes flight once again! After 8 years, and with the support of the **Preparatoria Federal Gilberto Martínez Gutiérrez**, the Rubik’s Cube challenge returns to the cradle of maize, where speed, strategy, and hawk-like vision are put to the test. Halcones Tehuacán 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: (SRB) Battle for Belgrade 2026 je dvadeset i deveto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Ovo takmičenje će se razlikovati od uobičajenih takmičenja koja smo do sada organizovali. Takmičari će biti podeljeni u 2 tima i zajedno će pokušati da ostvare što veći broj poena da bi osvojili nagrade. Pročitajte detaljnije o konceptu takmičenja** [ovde.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleforBelgrade2026#68110-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept) ------------------------ (ENG) Battle for Belgrade 2026 is the 29th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **This competition will be different from the ones we are usually organizing. Competitors will be divided into 2 teams, and will work together to try and achieve as many points as possible. Read more about the competition's concept** [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleforBelgrade2026#68110-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept)

Every tenth matters, every hundredth defines. 3 rounds of the fastest events. The greatest challenge: **beat the clock**. ​ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the **Municipality of San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. ​ Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla and the organization team for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Winter 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Julian Ostdal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Winter 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Julian Ostadal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is: **{_}@OCDSB"**" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Winter Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter A 2026 (Friday afternoon) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter B 2026 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {___@OCDSB}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter A 2026 (vendredi apres-midi) et Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter A 2026
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is: **{_}@OCDSB"**" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Winter Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter B 2026 (Saturday Morning) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon numéro d'étudiant est {numéro d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter B 2026 (samedi matin) et Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1NTU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3a118b424e278701313a1719599eeb8de50cc7ef/Screenshot_2025-10-20_at_8.56.54_PM.png) ### **대한민국 국적이 아닌 선수분들께서는 Korean Championship 2025에 참가 신청을 삼가주시기를 정중히 부탁드립니다.** Korean Championship은 대한민국에서 열리는 가장 중요한 WCA 대회입니다. 본 대회는 대한민국 챔피언을 선발하기 위한 대회인 만큼, 챔피언 타이틀이 대한민국 국적자에게 주어지기를 희망합니다. 다른 대회에는 언제든지 참가를 환영합니다. 모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 참가자를 위해 결승 라운드 참가 인원의 50% 또는 8명 중 더 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다. 우선 배정이 적용되는 라운드에서는, 이전 라운드에서 진출하는 참가자 중 대한민국 참가자가 먼저 선발되며, 이후 다른 국적의 상위 참가자가 선발됩니다. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. --- ### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for Korean Championship 2025.** Korean Championship is the most important WCA competition in Korea. As this competition is held to determine the national champion, we hope that the championship title will be awarded to competitors with Korean nationality. You are always welcome to participate in other competitions. For the final round of all events, 50% or up to 8 of the finalist spots (whichever is smaller) will be reserved for competitors representing the Republic of Korea. In rounds with reserved spots, advancing competitors will first include the top Korean competitors from the previous round, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). According to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must perform staff duties upon request from the organizers.

Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ### 🇧🇷 Português #### Competição Beneficente Essa competição é beneficente, com o intuito de arrecadar brinquedos para serem doados no Natal. Por isso, sugerimos que cada competidor leve um brinquedo em bom estado de uso para ser doado. Todos os brinquedos doados serão encaminhados ao [Projeto Providência](https://providens.arquidiocesebh.org.br/projetos/criancas-adolescentes-e-jovens/projeto-providencia/). Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. ​ Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BeneficenteNaEsquinaBH2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). ​ Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. ​ O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$15. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) ​ Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. ​ Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ​ ### 🇺🇸 English #### Charity Competition This competition is for charity, with the aim of collecting toys to be donated at Christmas. Therefore, we suggest that each competitor bring a toy in good condition to be donated. All the toys will be donated to [Projeto Providência](https://providens.arquidiocesebh.org.br/projetos/criancas-adolescentes-e-jovens/projeto-providencia/). Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. ​ Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BeneficenteNaEsquinaBH2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). ​ If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. ​ The registration fee is R$15. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) ​ Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. ​ By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cbb8741d80493ad5b6485076291772150d0aa596/LOGO%20FINAL%202025%201%20-%20COM%20FUNDO.png)

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Götalandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Götalandsmästerskapet 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Götaland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Götalandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2024#43304-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeasociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2024#43304-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". items.information: Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Será permitido, devido ao espaço do evento, no máximo dois acompanhantes por competidor, com uma taxa de R$ 5,00, por cada acompanhante a ser paga junto com a inscrição. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. - Due to the event space, a maximum of two companions per competitor, with a fee of R$5.00 for each companion to be paid together with registration. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; **Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante;** **Caso não seja informado o nome do competidor, a inscrição NÃO SERÁ ACEITA** Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. CASO SE REGISTRE NAS DUAS COMPETIÇÕES, SUA INSCRIÇÃO SERÁ REMOVIDA DA COMPETIÇÃO QUE TIVER MENOS COMPETIDORES** **ATENÇÃO: HAVERÁ INSCRIÇÕES NO DIA, MAS AS VAGAS SÃO LIMITADAS; PORTANTO, PRIORIZE SE INSCREVER O QUANTO ANTES** REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: **Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name;** **If the name of the competitor is not informed, the registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED** Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned There will be a limit of 35 competitors. IF YOU REGISTER IN BOTH COMPETITIONS, YOU'LL HAVE YOUR REGISTRATION REMOVED FROM THE COMPETITION WITH FEWER COMPETITORS** **THERE WILL BE ON THE SPOT REGISTRATION, HOWEVER, THE SPOTS ARE LIMITED; THEREFORE, MAKE SURE YOU REGISTER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE**

We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will host this competition. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--56311113734a1c22be204482adacfd1ca513311d/Commodore.jpg) **The Commodore Legacy Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Please see The Commodore Hotel tab for more information. ## Schedule Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## Notice of Filming Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Esse ano, estamos testando pela primeira vez um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! This year, we are testing for the first time one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMxMzUxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ebcd1154d0d69e028a1b6c9cdad267ec3d3ed26c/Your%20paragraph%20text.png) Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. - Só serão aceitas inscrições no local para a modalidade 3x3. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. - Only on-site registrations will be accepted for the 3x3 event. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Nikolaus Day 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Simon Praschl, Oskar Schöpl und Lukas Schwarz und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Linz Nikolaus Day 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Simon Praschl, Lukas Schwarz and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: Pēc trīs gadu pārtraukuma Latvijā atgriežas lielākās sacensības – **Latvijas čempionāts** – atdzimis un uzlabots! Sacensībās būs pārstāvētas gandrīz visas oficiālās WCA disciplīnas, kā arī notiks Iesācēju kauss un 3x3x3 kubs ar aizvērtām acīm pāros, lai piešķirtu pasākumam nelielu odziņu. Balvas varēs saņemt tikai Latvijas pilsoņi, taču sacensībās piedalīties aicināti dalībnieki no jebkuras valsts. FMC disciplīnas čempionāts notiks citā datumā. Šīs būs jau piektās sacensības, kas norisināsies Siguldā. ----------------------------------------------------- After a three-year break, the biggest competition in Latvia is back – **Latvian Championship** – reborn and improved! Amost all official WCA events will be featured, along with a Beginners’ Cup and 3x3x3 team-blindfolded to add a little twist to the competition. Only Latvian citizens are eligible for prizes, but participants from any country are welcome to compete. The FMC championship will be held on a different date. This will be the fifth competition to take place in Sigulda. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyMjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fda432baba49bf08fcf745df4e00a01d507ab85b/LV%C4%8CEMPIS2025ssss.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1MjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2c629bcad5d3a8ac071c808aa84be23cd16d534/cuboss-logo-400px.png)

items.name: Greek Nationals 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5OTU1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aac907f1eb0c44b518d47ef44f2346458b3cf2ce/image.png) Η σεζόν κλείνει με το 3ο Εθνικό Πρωτάθλημα Speedcubing το οποίο για πρώτη φορά θα πραγματοποιηθεί στην Βόρεια Ελλάδα και συγκεκεκριμένα στην Θεσσαλονίκη. Ποιοι θα είναι οι καλύτεροι για φέτος; Για 3 μέρες cubers απ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα αγωνιστούν για την ανάδειξη των πρωταθλητών του 2025! Η μεγαλύτερη γιορτή του κύβου όπως δεν θα την έχετε ξαναζήσει ποτέ! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The season wraps up with the 3rd National Speedcubing Championship, which for the very first time will take place in Northern Greece, in the city of Thessaloniki. Who will be the best of the year? For three days, cubers from all over the country – and beyond – will compete to crown the 2025 champions! The biggest cube celebration like you’ve never experienced before! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento será necessário informar o CPF e nome tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it will be required to inform an ID number for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Cubestuff Q4 Zwartkop 2025
items.information: ## Welcome Welcome to the fourth and last competition in the 2025 Cubestuff Challenge Series, this competition is open for beginners that can solve a 3x3 up to pro speedcubers who can solve any of the puzzles that we will have at the event. We are excited to host you at this unique venue for not only the competition but also the festivities that will form part of the weekend. See you soon :) ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## Venue ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3Njk0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dc8b9c172e37a9c37d113216be428f49d38a6dd4/Die%20Skuur.jpg) Die Skuur will have a menu to order food and drinks from, refreshments and snacks will also be available. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.name: Caveman Cubing Lohja 2025
items.information: Welcome to the lowest elevation WCA competition 100 meters below ground! Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. The competition venue is in a mine accessible by a 22 second elevator ride. There are no toilets or drinking water in the venue, but the visitor center on the surface has both available. Temperature in the mine is 6-8 °C and very humid. The venue is a separate room heated to 20 °C. You will receive a helmet and wearing it is mandatory in the mine, but it can be removed once at the venue. Bring your own lunch and drinks. Tervetuloa maailman syvimpään WCA-kilpailuun 100 metriä maanpinnan alla! Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Kilpailupaikka sijaitsee kaivoksessa, johon pääsee 22 sekunnin hissikyydillä. Kilpailupaikalla ei ole vessoja tai juomavettä, mutta molempiin on pääsy maan pinnalla vierailijakeskuksessa. Lämpötila kaivoksessa on 6-8 °C ja ilmankosteus korkea. Kilpailupaikka on 20 °C lämmitetty erillinen tila. Saat lainaan kypärän, jonka käyttö kaivoksessa on pakollista. Voit riisua kypärän kisapaikalla. Tuo mukana omat eväät ja juomat.

items.name: Dreht's Eich in Ergolding 2025
items.information: **Richtigs Deitsch** Griaß eich mitanand! Seid's recht herzlich willkomm'n bei der **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – da urboarischen Cubing-Competition, wo ned bloß d'Würfel, sondern aa d’Hirnwindung'n auf Hochtour'n laffa! Ob 3x3, 3BLD oder 7x7 – bei uns werd g'dreht, dass da Gummi glüht! Ganz egal, ob's no Anfänger seids, olle erfahrene Speedcuber oder einfach nur zum Zuaschau'n kemmts: Packt's eich zamm, kemmts vorbei und zoagt's, wos in eich steckt – oder lehnt’s eich z'ruck, genießt's de Stimmung und lasst's eich a guade Brezn🥨 schmecka (De miasad's aba seiba kaffa). Mia gfrein uns narrisch auf eich, und denkts dro: **Dreht's eich, aber gscheid!** **English** Hello everyone! A warm welcome to **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – the ultimate Bavarian cubing competition, where not just the cubes, but also your brains will be spinning at full speed! Whether it's 3x3, 3BLD, or 7x7 – we’re turning so fast the rubber’s burning! No matter if you're a beginner, a seasoned speedcuber, or just here to watch: Grab your stuff, come on over, and show us what you've got – or just sit back, soak in the vibe, and enjoy a good pretzel🥨 (you'll have to buy that yourself though). We’re super excited to see you, and don’t forget: **Spin it, and do it right!**

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.
